name: fancy-crates
description: Helps Rust developers spot outdated dependencies in `Cargo.toml` manifest files. Supports crates.io, alternate registries, and crates.io mirrors that offers the sparse protocol.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Fancy Crates runs cargo, git and cargo-deny in the workspace, which can execute code configured by the repository.

commands.title: Fancy Crates: Update Dependency to Latest

fancy-crates.useCargoCache.description: If true, Cargo's index cache is searched first before the registries. Cache must be stored in the sparse format.

fancy-crates.cratesIoIndex.description: The index URL of the default crates.io registry. Change this value only if you use a mirror of crates.io. The index must use the sparse protocol. Use a file URL if the mirror is on disk.

fancy-crates.cratesIoCache.markdownDescription: The index cache directory of the default crates.io registry. Change this value only if you use a remote or local mirror of crates.io. You can find the directories at CARGO_HOME/registry/index.

name.description: The name of the registry. It must be the same as your dependencies' "registry" key.

index.description: The index URL of the registry. The index must use the sparse protocol. Use a file URL if the registry is on disk.

cache.description: Cargo's index cache directory of the registry. You can find the directories at CARGO_HOME/registry/index. Cache is not searched for the registry if this property is not given.

docs.description: The docs URL of the registry, if one exists. The link to the docs of a specific version of a crate is obtained by `${docs}${name}/${version}`. This is only used when rendering hover messages on the decorators.

fancy-crates.registries.description: A list of alternate registries. The index of an alternate registry must support the sparse protocol.

host.description: Host name of the git server, e.g. "github.mycompany.com".

type.description: Hosting platform, used to build raw file URLs.

token.description: Access token for private repositories, sent as a Bearer token to this host only.

fancy-crates.gitHosts.markdownDescription: Self-hosted GitHub/GitLab servers used to read Cargo.toml of git dependencies over HTTP when `git archive` is not available.

fancy-crates.logLevel.description: Controls the verbosity of logging in the Output panel. Set to 'debug' for detailed troubleshooting.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: tsc && biome ci src && vite build --minify
